items.headline: Gene Chizik reveals his top five SEC quarterbacks ahead of Week 4
items.description: SEC Network's Chizik lists his top five quarterbacks heading into Week 4 action as he discusses why Trinidad Chambliss belongs in the top spot.

items.headline: No. 21 Florida's Jadan Baugh says Heisman talk lights a fire under him
items.description: Baugh joins SEC Now to explain how his dad, teammates and coaches constantly motivate him to run his way into the Heisman conversation.

items.headline: Aaron Philo leading Gators turnaround
items.description: Andrea Adelson breaks down why Aaron Philo has been a key piece of the Gators' offensive success and what that means for the rest of the season.

items.headline: Analyzing the surprise quarterbacks lighting it up in the SEC
items.description: SEC Network's Fozzy Whittaker and Gene Chizik shine light on the quarterbacks balling out in their rolls, flexing big-play ability and protecting the football.

items.headline: Fozzy's SEC Tiers: Which middle-tier teams are ready to break through?
items.description: After dividing the 16 SEC teams into four tiers, Fozzy Whitaker explains his rationale while fellow SEC Now analyst Gene Chizik weighs in.

items.headline: Debating who should be favored in No. 4 Ole Miss at No. 21 Florida
items.description: SEC Network's Gene Chizik and Fozzy Whittaker dive into why the Rebels could have a weakness exposed in their matchup against Jadan Baugh and the Gators.
